title: Change
description:
Please add an Assign Agent button on the Ticket Assignment screen.

Right now, when no agent exists in Agent Master, new tickets stay Pending with no agent. When the Manager clicks Assign Agent after agents are added, the system should:

Find all tickets with the status Pending and no assigned agent. If the Manager selects specific tickets, process only those.
For each ticket, find the active agents in Agent Master whose Preference matches the ticket’s Category.
Assign the tickets in a round-robin manner, in ascending order of the agents. The first ticket goes to the first agent, the second to the second agent, and so on. After the last agent, start again from the first.
Fill in the Assigned Agent and Assigned Agent Name fields.
Change the ticket Status from Pending to Assigned.

Other rules

Do not check agent availability.
If no agent matches a ticket’s category, leave that ticket as Pending.
Tickets that are already assigned must not be changed.
After the button is clicked, show a short message such as “3 tickets assigned, 1 still pending”.
